parameters.name: total_locations
parameters.description: Total number of locations in the set of tour nodes.

parameters.name: depot_index
parameters.description: Index of the designated depot location.

parameters.name: distance_matrix
parameters.description: Symmetric nonnegative travel distance matrix between locations.

variables.name: travel_decision
variables.description: Binary directed travel decision indicating whether the tour goes directly from location i to location j.

variables.name: ordering_variable
variables.description: Auxiliary ordering variable for each location to support subtour elimination.

variables.name: tour_sequence
variables.description: Ordered tour sequence of visited locations, with the depot appearing at both start and end.

constraints.name: travel_decision_binary
constraints.description: Directed travel decision variables must be binary

constraints.name: depot_start_end_outgoing
constraints.description: The depot must have exactly one outgoing travel decision

constraints.name: depot_start_end_incoming
constraints.description: The depot must have exactly one incoming travel decision

constraints.name: mtz_depot_order
constraints.description: Fix the depot ordering variable to the first position to anchor subtour elimination

constraints.name: mtz_bounds_non_depot
constraints.description: Ordering variables for non-depot locations must lie within the MTZ index range

constraints.name: mtz_subtour_elimination
constraints.description: Miller-Tucker-Zemlin subtour elimination constraints for all distinct non-depot pairs
constraints.formula: u_i - u_j + n x_{ij} \le n-1 \quad \forall i,j \in \mathcal{N}\setminus\{r\},\ i\ne j

constraints.name: depot_start_end_fixed_ends
constraints.description: The tour must start and end at the designated depot location

constraints.name: tour_sequence_covers_each_location_once
constraints.description: Every non-depot location must appear exactly once in the tour sequence, excluding the repeated depot at the end

constraints.name: degree_balance_for_all_locations
constraints.description: Each location must have exactly one outgoing and one incoming travel decision; this combines depot and non-depot degree conditions

constraints.name: no_self_loops
constraints.description: The tour cannot travel directly from a location to itself

objectives.name: total_travel_distance_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total travel distance of the single closed tour visiting every location exactly once and returning to the depot

final_objective.description: Minimize the total travel distance of the single closed tour. This is a single-objective TSP formulation using directed edge decisions, so the objective is the sum of selected arc distances.
